<div id="normal-shape" class="normal-demo">

<div class="normal-top">

<div class="normal-controls">

<label class="normal-control">
<span>μ</span>
<input
  data-param="mean"
  type="range"
  min="-2"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="0">
<span data-value="mean"></span>
</label>

<label class="normal-control">
<span>σ</span>
<input
  data-param="sd"
  type="range"
  min="0.3"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="1">
<span data-value="sd"></span>
</label>

</div>

<div class="normal-result"></div>

</div>

<svg></svg>

</div>

<script>
normalDemo("#normal-shape", {
  xmin: -5,
  xmax: 5,
  ymax: 1.4,
  height: 300
});
</script>
